QuestInfo.name: Town Filled With Suspicion
QuestInfo.0: You come to a newly-discovered area, #m310000000#, but no one will talk to you. All the residents seem to go about their business without saying a word... you wonder what's going on... Ask Headmaster #b#p2152000##k, who looks the most gentlemanly out of everyone.
QuestInfo.1: Headmaster #p2152000# says the reason the townspeople are avoiding you is probably because they think you are one of #r<them>#k. He says to talk to #bpeople dressed in black in this town#k if you want to learn more about it.\n\n#y23906# #b(#u23906#)#k
QuestInfo.2: The Black Wings rule #m310000000#, and the townspeople have no choice but to accept it. Because everyone in #m310000000# despises the Black Wings, the overall climate of the town is far from happy and inviting. But, since you've resolved the misunderstanding, you should be able to talk to the residents.

0.0: Hello, are you new here? \r\n#L0##bYes, this is my first time here. Things seem so dreary! And why is everyone so unfriendly?#l\n#k
0.1: Well, the townspeople are avoiding you because they suspect that you might be one of #r<them>#k. Normally, everyone is very friendly.\r\n#L0##b<Them>? Who do you mean by <Them>?#l\n#k
0.2: See for yourself! Walk around town and I'm sure you'll notice some #bpeople wearing black#k... Talk to the #bfat guy#k and you'll be able to find out more.

yes.0: His name is #bBavan#k.\rYou can meet him on the #bright#k. \r\nIt... It won't be a pleasant meeting.

no.0: As long as the townspeople suspect you of being one of <them>, they will avoid you. Don't you think it would be a good idea to ease their suspicions?

1.0: So you met #p2152016#. I told you it wouldn't be fun. Still, #p2152016# is the nicest of all the <Watchmen>.
1.1: As you've undoubtedly learned by now, our town is under the control of the Black Wings. And we absolutely detest it! That's why we were suspicious of you, an outsider.

yes.0: Now that it's been confirmed that you are not one of <Them>, the townspeople won't be suspicious of you anymore. Allow me to welcome you to #m310000000#. As long as you do not become friendly with the Black Wings, the residents of #m310000000# will accept you as their friend.

quest.0: Have you not met the #bfat person wearing black#k yet? He shouldn't be too hard to find... His name is #b#p2152016##k.
